subject: Correct cross type for DO mice crossed back with B6

messages.author: 84f3288c7251590c
messages.subject: Correct cross type for DO mice crossed back with B6
parts:
I have an experiment in which we have the DO mice crossed back with the B6 founder strain. During the analysis I used the DO as cross type. Is this appropriate and will it affect the allele probability function? Thank you for any advice!

Justin

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: Correct cross type for DO mice crossed back with B6
parts:
The "do" cross type is not appropriate, but there's a cross type "dof1" that should work. The founder genotypes would include 9 founders: the 8 CC founders plus the other parent, so for your data the B6 strain would be repeated.

karl

On Wednesday, April 3, 2019 at 5:14:37 PM UTC+2, Justin Hackett wrote:
I have an experiment in which we have the DO mice crossed back with the B6 founder strain. During the analysis I used the DO as cross type. Is this appropriate and will it affect the allele probability function? Thank you for any advice!

Justin

messages.subject: Re: Correct cross type for DO mice crossed back with B6
parts:
Thank you very much, I am a novice to doing this work so I am unsure of how to proceed. I know in the DO mice the "GM_foundergeno" files have the founder strains and their SNP genotypes per chromosome. Would I need to repeat the B6 founder here with the letter "I"? How would I then change the "geno_codes" in the control file.

Justin

On Wednesday, April 3, 2019 at 2:33:01 PM UTC-4, Karl Broman wrote:
The "do" cross type is not appropriate, but there's a cross type "dof1" that should work. The founder genotypes would include 9 founders: the 8 CC founders plus the other parent, so for your data the B6 strain would be repeated.

karl

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl2-disc] Re: Correct cross type for DO mice crossed back with B6
parts:
Yes, repeat the B6 founder as a 9th row, with whatever letter you want.
You shouldn't need to change the genotype codes.

karl

messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl2-disc] Re: Correct cross type for DO mice crossed back with B6
parts:
Cross DO mice to B6, and everyone has a intact chromosome from B6. So all that matters is the allele on the other chromosome. There are 8 possible genotypes, BA, BB, BC, ..., BH. So we just label them A-H.

karl

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl2-disc] Re: Correct cross type for DO mice crossed back with B6
parts:
Yes it assumes that the chromosome from the B6 parent is entirely B6. I’m not sure what you mean by “where recombination may have occurred”; in the F1 of B6 and a DO mouse, the recombination can only occur in the DO parent and B6 parent, but not between them.

karl
